them.zh: SCIP 索引器和工具做的

steps.en: Install the SCIP indexer for your language
steps.zh: 装上对应语言的 SCIP 索引器

steps.en: Run it at the project root, usually as a CI step on each commit
steps.zh: 在项目根目录运行，通常作为每次提交的 CI 步骤

steps.en: Type-checks the project with the real compiler and resolves every identifier to its definition
steps.zh: 用真正的编译器做类型检查，把每个标识符解析到它的定义

steps.en: Writes one Protobuf index with a globally unique string name for every symbol
steps.zh: 写出一个 Protobuf 索引，每个符号一个全局唯一的字符串名

steps.en: Load the index into your consumer: Sourcegraph, or your own tool via the Go/Rust bindings
steps.zh: 把索引交给消费方：Sourcegraph，或用 Go/Rust 绑定写的自家工具

steps.en: Bindings expose documents, symbols and exact occurrence ranges for definition/reference lookups
steps.zh: 绑定暴露文档、符号和精确出现位置，供跳转定义和查找引用使用

value.en: Compiler-accurate go-to-definition and find-references, computed once per commit and queryable offline
value.zh: 编译器级精确的跳转定义和查找引用，每个提交算一次，之后离线可查

sources: https://github.com/scip-code/scip#readme (schema, Go/Rust bindings, scip CLI, list of indexers)
